title: S-trajectory-gnp (per-village monthly, GNP market suite)
description: Schema DRAFT for the GNP-side equivalent of the DKK counterfactual-S-trajectory-v4: a per-village monthly sold_share trajectory serialized from MarketDynamicsEngine (spectrum_os/extensions/market_suite_dynamics.py), one document per commodity market. STATUS: draft v1 — emitted by build_village_monthly_document(); the engine-side implementation is live, the dual-world-bifurcation constitution entry ('GNP 不適用 S 軌道') is owned by the main agent and is NOT modified by this draft. This schema describes market-structure trajectory quantities, not force ratios.

track.description: Same track vocabulary as DKK S-trajectory v4 (projection | intervention).

worldline.description: Worldline tag: beta_1 GNP market suite. DKK S-trajectory v4 carries no explicit worldline tag (worker-state side implied); GNP must always tag.

trajectory_quantity.description: Must declare a market-structure quantity: village sold_share (marketed share of harvest, clamped [0.10, 1.0]). Siblings in the same dimension family: p_farmgate / retention_rate / kappa / hhi.

not_dkk_s.description: Mandatory asymmetry declaration: this is NOT the DKK ForceField S = R/(R+C). Per SLOT-MIRROR-SCHEMA §六 (2026-09-03 用戶裁定), GNP dynamics = actors_n=N with kappa(t) collusion index; the GNP-side 'trajectory' dimension is market structure, never a revolutionary/conservative force ratio. Applying S=R/(R+C) to GNP village data is a category error.

kappa_range.description: kappa(t) collusion index range: 0 = cartel split / cutthroat bidding, 1 = quota cartel / full monopsony collusion (SLOT-MIRROR §六).

dates.description: Monthly labels generated as {1914 + m//12}-{(m%12)+1:02} for m=0..36. First = 1914-01, last = 1917-01.

model_specification.description: Must state the transmission law: sold_share_v(t) = sold_share_v,1914 * (P_farmgate(t)/P_1914)^epsilon_p * [1 - epsilon_kappa*(kappa(t)-kappa_0)], clamped to [0.10, 1.0].

parameter_tagging.description: All transmission parameters are [DERIVED_PROXY]; no engine fitting (MODIFICATION-LAW: the engine never fits parameters).

villages.description: Village-major layout (asymmetry vs DKK v4's month-major S_monthly[month][node]): one entry per village, each carrying its per-regime monthly series.

sold_share_1914.description: Empirical baseline from the 1914 census volume.

additionalProperties.description: Engine-native monthly sold_share (not interpolation). series[m] is the value at dates[m].

tolerance.description: Same 1e-6 convention as the DKK S-trajectory v4 curation cross-check (row-endpoint vs annual, max |delta| < 1e-6).

x-era-rules.grid: Fixed 37-point monthly grid 1914-01..1917-01 shared by all villages, regimes and markets (mirrors DKK v4's fixed dates[37] grid ending at the anchor year-01 month).
x-era-rules.anchor_semantics: dates[0]=1914-01 is the empirical baseline year (census sold_share_1914); dates[36]=1917-01 is the anchor/bust endpoint whose values must equal the annual three-regime village readouts.
x-era-rules.regime_era_marker: Under cartel_split the collusion-collapse window opens at month index m=24 (dates[24]=1916-01, kappa decay exp(-0.35*(m-24))); free_evolution has no exogenous era marker (endogenous ODE).
x-era-rules.era_boundary_law: No date may be invented outside the grid; extensions of the horizon require a new engine run and a schema version bump, not label edits.

symmetric: 37-point monthly grid with anchor-year-01 terminal month (dates[36] == '{anchor}-01').
Per-node monthly trajectory matrix (DKK: S_monthly over 60 nodes; GNP: villages[].sold_share_monthly over 120 villages).
Endpoint cross-check against the annual/anchor readout with tolerance 1e-6.
Generated by an engine, never hand-authored; parameter tagging mandatory ([DERIVED_PROXY]).
asymmetric: DIMENSION: GNP trajectory quantity is sold_share (market-structure family: p_farmgate/retention_rate/kappa/hhi), NOT DKK S = R/(R+C). Never join the two quantities in one comparison; compare structures, not values (GENERAL-PRINCIPLES: comparison typology — different types are not commensurable).
LAYOUT: GNP is village-major (villages[].sold_share_monthly[regime][m]); DKK v4 is month-major (S_monthly[m][node]).

REGIMES: GNP carries a three-regime counterfactual block (free_evolution / cartel_lock / cartel_split) per village; DKK v4 carries a single trajectory per node (projection vs intervention live in separate files).
AUXILIARY STATE: GNP exposes kappa(t) collusion index in [0,1] as the driving state; DKK S-trajectory has no kappa (kappa identical to 1 on the worker-state side, per SLOT-MIRROR §六).
WORLDLINE TAG: GNP must carry worldline=beta_1_gnp; DKK v4 implies the worker-state worldline.
